billing.checkout_failed: We could not confirm your payment yet

billing.checkout_success_desc: You are now on the {{plan}} plan
billing.checkout_success_generic: Your payment went through and your plan is active.
billing.description: Your community's plan, members and payments.

billing.load_error: The plans could not be loaded.
billing.no_invoices_desc: No invoices have been generated yet
billing.plans_description: Choose the plan that fits your community.
billing.processing_desc: Your payment is being processed. This may take a moment.

billing.upgrade_message_placeholder: For example: we would like a larger plan, or we have paid our invoice.
billing.upgrade_sent: Your message has been sent to the platform team.
billing.upgrade_modal_desc: Ask about your plan, a payment or a pause. The platform team will reply by email.
billing.pause_modal_body: Members will see a paused page and will not be able to use the community. Its admins keep the admin panel. Nothing is deleted.
billing.exempt_modal_body: An exempt community is never paused, and neither is any community below it.
billing.standing_failed: That could not be done. Nothing was changed.

paused_banner.inherited: This community is paused because the community above it is paused. Paused since {{date}}.
paused_banner.limit_approaching: This community has {{used}} active members, {{percent}}% of its plan's limit of {{max}}.
paused_banner.limit_over: This community has {{used}} active members, more than its plan's limit of {{max}}. A bigger plan may be needed.
paused_banner.limit_reached: This community has reached its plan's limit of {{max}} active members.
paused_banner.overdue: Payment for this community is {{days}} days overdue. Please bring it up to date so that the community is not paused.
paused_banner.own_parent: This community is paused. Members cannot use it until payment is brought up to date with {{payee}}. Paused since {{date}}.
paused_banner.own_platform: This community is paused. Members cannot use it until payment is brought up to date with the platform team. Paused since {{date}}.
paused_banner.unknown: This community is paused. Members cannot use it. The reason could not be loaded; please reload the page.
paused_banner.rule_block_joining: New members cannot join while it is over its limit.
paused_banner.rule_pause_maybe: If it stays over its limit, the community may be paused.
paused_banner.rule_pause_on: If it is still over its limit on {{date}}, the community will be paused.
paused_banner.rule_upgrade: If it stays over its limit, it may be moved up to a larger plan.
paused_banner.open_billing: Open Billing to check your card and message the platform team

automation.action_member_limit_over: Over the limit: {{used}} of {{max}} active members
automation.action_member_limit_reached: At the limit: {{used}} of {{max}} active members
automation.action_member_limit_restore: Opened again: back within the member limit
automation.action_member_limit_suspend: Paused for being over the limit: {{used}} of {{max}} active members
automation.action_payment_final_warning: Final warning: {{days}} days late, to be paused on {{pause_date}}
automation.action_payment_waiting_for_stripe: Not paused yet: {{days}} days late and Stripe is still retrying the card. Paused on {{pause_date}} at the latest
automation.card_retry_help: After this many days late the community is paused, whatever Stripe says.
automation.card_retry_max_days_late: Longest wait for a card Stripe is still retrying: days late
automation.limit_warning_percent: Member-limit warning at this percentage of the plan
automation.load_failed: The settings could not be loaded.
automation.off_note: Switched off. Nothing is sent and no community is paused. The list below shows what would happen.
automation.on_note: Switched on. Every morning, reminders and warnings are emailed, and communities are paused when the rules below say so.
automation.over_limit_days: Days over the limit before pausing or moving up
automation.over_limit_label: When a community goes over its member limit
automation.preview_failed: The list of what would happen today could not be loaded.
automation.reminder_days: Reminders: days before the paid-until date
automation.reminder_days_help: Comma separated, for example 30, 14, 7, 1. Leave it empty to send no reminders.
automation.save_failed: The settings could not be saved.
automation.switch_label: Run the automatic checks every morning
automation.title: Automatic checks
automation.decision_no_plan_fits: no plan offered to it is big enough
automation.decision_custom_price: it has a specially agreed price
automation.decision_card_subscription: it pays by card, so the platform team moves it by hand
automation.last_run_never: The morning check has not run yet.
automation.last_run_off: Last ran {{date}}. The checks were switched off, so nothing was looked at.
automation.last_run_failed: The last run, on {{date}}, failed. Something may not have been done. The error is in the server log.

control.amount_invalid: Enter the amount as a plain number with at most two decimal places.
control.currency_required: Choose the currency of the amount.
control.currently_paid_until: Currently paid until {{date}}. The new date must be later.
control.history_empty: No payments have been recorded yet.
control.history_failed: The payment history could not be loaded.
control.history_card_note: A card payment cannot be voided here. It is refunded in Stripe.
control.history_dispute_open: Disputed on {{date}}. Open: it is answered in Stripe.
control.history_dispute_won: Disputed on {{date}}. Ended: the payment stands.
control.history_dispute_lost: Disputed on {{date}}. Lost: the money went back to the cardholder.
control.paid_until_help: The community is paid up to and including this date. Leave it empty to stop tracking a date.
control.payer_help_default: The platform decides: a community with a live Stripe subscription pays the platform by card. Without one, a community under another community pays its parent, and any other pays the platform by invoice.
control.payer_help_not_billed: Never billed. The automatic payment checks leave it alone.
control.payer_help_parent: Pays its parent community, not the platform.
control.payer_help_platform_card: Pays the platform by card through Stripe. No reminders are sent before the date, and Stripe retries a failed card.
control.payer_help_platform_invoice: Pays the platform by invoice or bank transfer. Record its payments here by hand.
control.payment_paid_until_label: Now paid up to and including
control.record_payment_help: For a payment that did not come through Stripe, such as a bank transfer. Saving it sets the paid-until date to the date below and keeps the payment in the history.
control.record_payment_help_branch: For a payment this community made to {{payee}}. Saving it sets the paid-until date to the date below and keeps the payment in the history.
control.void_help: The payment stays in the history, struck through, with your reason. It is never deleted.
control.void_date_note: Voiding does not change the paid-until date. If the date should change, set it below.
control.void_date_none: No paid-until date is recorded now.
control.review_date_help: A reminder for the platform team. Nothing happens automatically on this date.
control.card_payer_note: This community pays by card. Its plan and price are changed from its own Billing page. Only the notes and the review date can be changed here.
control.load_failed: The list could not be loaded.
control.agreed_price_help: Leave these empty to charge the plan's own price. A special price replaces the plan's price. A verified non-profit then pays 20% less, and a discount is taken off after that.
control.team_only_help: For the platform team only. The community does not see these.
control.paid_until_after_plan: The plan is saved. Now set the date this community is paid up to, so that reminders and checks can start.
control.plans_failed: The plans could not be loaded. Close this box and try again.
control.amount_from_plan: Filled in from the plan's price. Change it if a different amount was paid.

over_limit_rule.automation_off_note: The platform’s automatic checks are switched off, so nothing here acts until the platform team switches them on. You can still set the rule now.
over_limit_rule.card_help: Applies to every community that pays this community and has no rule of its own.
over_limit_rule.card_title: When a community goes over its member limit
over_limit_rule.days_help: Leave it empty to follow the default.
over_limit_rule.days_help_default_one: Leave it empty to follow the default of {{count}} day.
over_limit_rule.days_help_default_other: Leave it empty to follow the default of {{count}} days.
over_limit_rule.days_invalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 365.
over_limit_rule.dialog_help: What happens when this community goes over its plan’s member limit. Saving a change starts the count of days over again.
over_limit_rule.explain_block_joining: Nobody new can join while the community is at or over its member limit. Existing members are not affected.
over_limit_rule.explain_none: The community’s admins are warned by email. Nothing else happens.
over_limit_rule.explain_pause: After the set number of days over, the community is paused. It opens again once it is back within its member limit.
over_limit_rule.explain_upgrade: After the set number of days over, the community is moved to the smallest plan that fits its active members.
over_limit_rule.label_upgrade: Move up to the next plan
over_limit_rule.save_failed: The over-limit rule could not be saved.
over_limit_rule.upgrade_by_hand: Move up (platform team does this one by hand)
over_limit_rule.follow_default_card: Follow the default (currently: Warn only — a move is done by the platform team)

plan_facts.already_by_card: This community pays by card. Choosing another plan changes that card payment. It does not start a second one.
plan_facts.card_fix_first: The last card payment did not go through. Use Manage Payment on the Billing page to put the card right before changing plan.
plan_facts.change_confirm_body: Your card payment is changed, not doubled. The change happens now. The difference for the rest of the current period is charged, or credited, on your next invoice.
plan_facts.setup_fee_first_payment: The one-off setup fee is added to the first card payment.

own_billing.card_failed: The last card payment did not go through. Use Manage Payment to check or change the card.
own_billing.load_failed: The billing details could not be loaded.
own_billing.members_help: Active members are those who signed in within the last 90 days, here and in any communities below this one.
own_billing.no_plan: This community has no plan yet.
own_billing.pays_parent_note: This community pays its parent community. Its plan and payments are arranged with them, not here.
own_billing.visiting_note: You are visiting this community, so its billing page is not shown. Its plan and card payments are managed by its own admins and by the platform team.
own_billing.request_failed: The request could not be sent. Please try again.

revenue.action_standing_children_over_limit_rule: Over-limit rule set for the communities below it
revenue.desc: What the platform itself expects to be paid by its communities, and the latest billing changes.
revenue.how_counted: Money is counted only for communities that pay the platform, by card or by invoice, are on a plan, and are not exempt or paused. A community that pays the community above it is that community's income, not the platform's. A yearly payer counts at a twelfth of its yearly price. Euro and pounds are never added together.
revenue.no_plans: No community is on a plan yet.
revenue.nothing_expected: No community pays the platform yet.
